portfolio.title: I'm Javier Bernal Acosta. Fullstack Developer & Automation Specialist.
portfolio.description: Full Stack Web Developer with over 3 years of experience combining strong software engineering foundations with advanced adoption and integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI-Assisted Engineering). Specialized in the architecture and implementation of modern ecosystems built with Next.js, React, Astro, and Headless WordPress solutions (custom plugin development and high-performance REST API consumption/creation). Enhancing the design and software engineering lifecycle through the synergy of Figma, Stitch, and generative AI workflows, accelerating prototyping and implementation of UI/UX architectures for intuitive admin panels and CRM systems. Expert in orchestrating and integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) within IDEs/AI agents, connecting local contexts and third-party tools to automate complex tasks, optimize code maintainability, and maximize deployment velocity across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Extensive background in process automation and WebOps (n8n / Docker containerization), critical database migrations, and designing scalable e-commerce architectures (Shopify / WooCommerce).
